question: How does this Agreement renew, and how much notice is required to stop renewal?
ground_truth_answer: The Agreement has an initial 12-month term and automatically renews for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives thirty (30) days' notice of non-renewal.

expected_citations.span_hint: This Agreement has an initial term of twelve (12) months, automatically renewing for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides thirty (30) days' notice of non-renewal.
